newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algiers car bomb kills seven - APS.
newsitem.headline: Algiers car bomb kills seven - APS.

text.p: A car bomb killed seven people in the Algiers suburb of Hussein-Dey on Thursday, the Algerian news agency APS said.
It said 68 people were injured. A car bomb in the Algerian capital had killed eight people on Monday.
APS quoted security services as saying 34 of the wounded were still in hospital and the others were released after first aid.
The Armed Islamic Group (GIA), Algeria's most ruthless Moslem fundamentalist rebel group, has in the past claimed responsibility for such attacks and vowed to carry out more.
About 60,000 people have died in Algeria in the fighting that started in 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election that radical Islamists were poised to win.
